key_insight: For the scheduling instance and initialization studied, an entanglement-free variational quantum circuit found feasible schedules without benefiting from entangling gates.
engineering_relevance: Day-by-day decomposition and compact binary encoding make skill-aware workforce scheduling tractable within simulated batches of at most 30 qubits.
method: Formulate multi-skill scheduling as a QUBO with worker capacities, priorities, deadlines, and rescheduling stability.
Solve one day at a time, propagating remaining workload with logarithmic binary encoding.
Compare linear and brick-wall entangling ansätze against a parameter-matched entanglement-free reference using COBYLA and Adam with SPSA gradients.
evidence_signal: In simulation, the entanglement-free reference yielded feasible schedules with both optimizers; with COBYLA, it came closest to the required workload at a fraction of the entangled circuits' simulation cost.
watch_item: Results are limited to the studied instance and initialization; broader scheduling performance and quantum-hardware advantage remain unestablished.
paper_title: A Variational Quantum Algorithm for Multi-Skill Project Scheduling
